about.title: Fullerton Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the paperwork arrives before the grief has anywhere to go. Fullerton families know this. In 2025, the city recorded 4 traffic deaths alongside 734 injury collisions, and each of those numbers stands for a household that changed overnight. Collision counts run highest along Harbor Boulevard, Euclid Street, Orangethorpe Avenue and the southbound side of SR-57, and they tend to peak on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. Not every wrongful death claim begins on a road. A fall at a workplace, a defective product, or a preventable medical error can lead to the same civil action. California limits who may bring that claim, starting with a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then moving to certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a public entity is involved. Our team handles wrongful death cases on contingency, so you can discuss your family's options without adding another bill to the stack.

about.ctaText: Talk with us about your family's options

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. We can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is real, and sometimes short
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, but a claim against a city, county or state agency carries a much tighter window. Reaching out early protects that right.

items.title: Every loss on the table, not just the receipts
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, but also the loss of love, companionship and guidance. We work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our loved one died in a crash on SR-57 near Fullerton. Does that change the deadline?
items.answer: It might. If any part of the claim involves a public entity, such as Caltrans for a state highway or the City of Fullerton for a local street, California requires a government claim to be filed much sooner than the usual two years, often within six months. We can sort out which parties are involved and which deadline applies, which is one reason we encourage families not to wait.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from any criminal prosecution. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof, so a family can pursue compensation whether or not charges are filed or result in a conviction.

items.question: How much does it cost to speak with an attorney?
items.answer: It costs nothing. We offer a free consultation, and our team handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no attorney fee is owed unless there is a recovery.
